issues.jp_before: 母[はは]の料理[りょうり]は簡単[かんたん]な{わりに|pt-kuseni}、とてもおいしい。
issues.problem: Distractor くせに is acceptable in casual speech with inanimate subjects (安いくせにうまい), giving nearly the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor くせに with せいで.

issues.jp_before: この家[いえ]は駅[えき]から遠[とお]い{わりに|pt-kuseni}、家賃[やちん]が高[たか]い。
issues.problem: Distractor くせに (遠いくせに家賃が高い) is a natural colloquial complaint with the same meaning.
issues.action: Replaced distractor くせに with せいで.

issues.jp_before: 毎日[まいにち]八時間[はちじかん]寝[ね]ている{わりに|pt-kuseni}、朝[あさ]はいつも眠[ねむ]い。
issues.problem: English 'Considering that I sleep eight hours..., I am always sleepy' is unnatural and misstates the contrast.
issues.action: English changed to 'I sleep eight hours a night, yet I am always sleepy in the morning.'

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]は、今日[きょう]の晩[ばん]ご飯[はん]はカレーにする{と言[い]っていました|pt-quote}。
issues.problem: Distractor ことを言っていました (カレーにすることを言っていた, 'she mentioned making curry') is grammatical and fits the English nearly as well.
issues.action: Replaced distractor with ことを思っていました.

issues.jp_before: 公園[こうえん]に「ひまわり」{という|pt-toiu}名前[なまえ]の花[はな]が咲[さ]いています。
issues.problem: English 'Flowers named sunflowers' is awkward and loses the naming sense.
issues.action: English changed to 'Flowers called himawari (sunflowers) are blooming in the park.'
